Item 6. Selected Financial Data
The selected financial data presented for each of the five years ended December 31, 2019 is derived from our audited consolidated financial statements. The selected financial data presented should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements, the notes to our consolidated financial statements and Item 7 “Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations.”
(1) On January 1, 2019, we adopted Accounting Standards Codification (ASC) 842, Leases, using the modified retrospective method at the beginning of the period of adoption, January 1, 2019, through the recognition of a lease obligation and corresponding right of use asset. Results for reporting periods beginning after January 1, 2019 are presented under ASC 842, while prior periods amount were not adjusted and continue to be reported in accordance with ASC 840, Leases.
(2) On January 1, 2018, we adopted ASC 606, Revenue from Contracts with Customers, using the modified retrospective method applied to those contracts that were not substantially complete as of January 1, 2018. Results for reporting periods beginning after January 1, 2018 are presented under ASC 606, while prior period amounts were not adjusted and continue to be reported in accordance with ASC 605, Revenue Recognition.
(3) The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, enacted on December 22, 2017, reduces the U.S. corporate tax rate from 35% to 21% beginning in 2018. Due to the enactment of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, our income tax expense was reduced by $50.6 million for the year ended December 31, 2017 from the re-measurement of our existing deferred tax assets and liabilities.
(4) Over the past five years, we completed 7 acquisitions. In aggregate, these acquisitions have added $343.6 million in goodwill. For additional information on our recent acquisitions, see Note 5 to our consolidated financial statements in Item 8.

selected.record_copy_policy: Exact original JSON line; every original field retained unchanged. Answer fields were not used as selection features.

This is the clearest natural candidate found with a possible newly added Average Total Assets dependency, without using an answer or prior success/failure.

expected_target.resolution: Exact canonical name; no alias-priority changes.

Return on Assets = Net Profit / Average Total Assets

operands.metric: Total Assets at Beginning of Period

expected_paths.source_formula: Average Total Assets = (Total Assets at Beginning of Period + Total Assets at End of Period) ÷ 2

selected.expected_operand_alignment: 2017 Net Income and 2017 Total Assets are explicitly tabulated. A beginning/end average-assets path additionally needs explicit temporal binding of 2017 opening assets to the 2016 closing balance and 2017 closing assets to the 2017 balance; no unsupported period substitution is allowed.
selected.expected_operator_coverage: OMD should expose graph formulas for the named ROA. Depending on supported denominator constraints, OPE.metric may compute a direct-assets path or recurse into Average Total Assets. Verify coverage is an expectation only and must be confirmed in live traces.
selected.new_formula_coverage: Average Total Assets source:40024c9b5d4402430e09 is one of the 108 additions, but pre-existing equivalent average-assets formulas also remain. No guarantee the new formula will be selected; do not force or reorder formulas for this sample.
limits: Graph contains both end-of-period-assets and average-assets ROA definitions; the question does not specify the denominator convention.
These denominator definitions can legitimately differ and must not be treated as algebraically equivalent merely because both are labelled ROA. Preserve constraints or abstain if unresolved.
